description: Check a word across every TLD with registrar prices, watch the aftermarket, and generate names with DomainsGPT, all from the terminal with a local store the site itself does not offer.

tools.name: domains_check
tools.description: Check availability, premium flag, price, aftermarket status, and popularity (tldCount) for a dictionary word on one TLD, such as smart.com; words outside the dictionary return HTTP 500. Required: domain. Returns the DomainCheck.

params.name: domain
params.description: Full domain, word plus TLD, such as oasis.io

tools.name: domains_count
tools.description: Count available one-word domains for a TLD with the same filters as search; returns a bare integer; normally public, but the site sometimes answers 401 to anonymous callers, in which case auth login --chrome supplies the session. Required: tld. Optional: search, category, price (plus 2 more).

tools.name: gpt_usage
tools.description: Show DomainsGPT usage and quota for the current identity; anonymous callers get 10, signed-in accounts more. Returns the Usage.

tools.name: listings_count
tools.description: Count aftermarket listings matching the filters; returns a bare integer. Optional: tld, registrar, min-length (plus 1 more).

tools.name: listings_filters
tools.description: List the TLDs that currently have aftermarket listings, with counts. Optional: registrar. Returns array of ListingFilter.

tools.name: listings_list
tools.description: List aftermarket listings, 100 per page, filtered by TLD, registrar, and word length, sorted by domain, price, bids, or ending time. Optional: tld, registrar, min-length (plus 3 more). Returns array of Listing.

params.name: tld
params.description: TLD slug filter such as co

params.name: registrar
params.description: Registrar slug filter; only godaddy has listings today

tools.name: tlds_get
tools.description: Get one TLD with its description, registrar price list, cheapest registrar, and example sites; unknown TLDs return an empty record. Required: tld. Returns the TldDetail.

params.name: tld
params.description: TLD slug without the dot, such as ai, com, or io

tools.name: tlds_list
tools.description: List all 93 TLDs with registration counts, top-10M site counts, page views, and minimum registration price, ordered by popularity unless --sort-alpha is set. Optional: sort-alpha (default: false). Returns array of Tld.

params.name: sort-alpha
params.description: Sort alphabetically by TLD instead of by popularity

tools.name: words_count
tools.description: Count dictionary words matching the directory filters; returns a bare integer. Optional: contains, category.

tools.name: words_get
tools.description: Get one dictionary word with its category tags. Required: word. Returns the WordDetail.

tools.name: words_list
tools.description: List dictionary words; with --prefix up to 10 autocomplete matches, otherwise a category or substring directory of 100 words per page in alphabetical order with categories. Optional: prefix, contains, category (plus 1 more). Returns array of Word.

novel_features.name: Brainstorm pipeline
novel_features.description: Generate DomainsGPT names, keep only the available ones with price, cheapest registrar, and a dictionary flag, and save the batch locally; one call per TLD, quota 10 anonymous.

novel_features.name: Shortlist recheck
novel_features.description: Re-check every word and TLD you looked up before and report what changed: taken, freed, premium, price, or popularity.

novel_features.name: Auction ranking
novel_features.description: Rank aftermarket auctions by how contested the word is across TLDs, price relative to fresh registration, and bid pace.

novel_features.name: Cross-TLD intersection
novel_features.description: Find dictionary words that are free on every TLD you list, or free on one and taken on another; needs the lifetime-pass session from auth login --chrome or auth login --cookies-file.

novel_features.name: Dictionary mining
novel_features.description: Filter the 27,627-word dictionary by several categories at once, length, prefix, or glob, offline after a one-time words mine --refresh.

novel_features.name: TLD inventory
novel_features.description: Compare how many available one-word domains each TLD still has for a category and length filter, next to its cheapest registration price (public route).

novel_features.name: Cross-TLD check
novel_features.description: Check one word, or a file of words, across the most-viewed TLDs or all 93, with availability, premium flag, popularity, and the cheapest registrar price per TLD.

novel_features.name: Side-by-side compare
novel_features.description: Compare several full domains in one table: available, premium, price, popularity, and cheapest registrar, with the cheapest available one called out.

novel_features.name: Domain hacks
novel_features.description: Find domain hacks: split a word so its ending is one of the 93 TLDs (sm.art), or list dictionary words ending in a TLD.

novel_features.name: TLD price drift
novel_features.description: Record registrar price snapshots for every TLD and report which prices moved since an earlier snapshot.

novel_features.name: Aftermarket watch
novel_features.description: Diff the aftermarket feed against the last run: new listings, price or bid changes, listings that disappeared, and auctions ending within a window.

novel_features.name: DomainsGPT generate
novel_features.description: Run DomainsGPT and get the streamed names back as real JSON, optionally only the available ones.
